criteria.title: A mobility limitation stops a daily activity at home
criteria.requirement: A mobility examination documents a limitation that prevents the member from completing at least one daily activity in the home, such as toileting, dressing or preparing a meal.

criteria.title: A cane or walker does not resolve it
criteria.requirement: The examination states that a cane or a walker does not resolve the limitation.

criteria.title: A manual wheelchair does not resolve it
criteria.requirement: The examination states that the member cannot propel a manual wheelchair far enough to complete the daily activity.

criteria.title: The home accommodates the chair
criteria.requirement: A home assessment dated within the 60 days before the request confirms that doorways, turning space and floor surfaces accommodate a power wheelchair.

criteria.title: The member can operate it safely
criteria.requirement: The examination documents that the member has the vision, judgement and hand function to operate the controls safely.

evidence.text: Condition: G35.D Multiple sclerosis, unspecified. Onset 2009-02-14.

Clinical note (Mobility examination, dated 2026-09-02T12:00:00Z):
Face-to-face mobility examination, 2026-09-02.
She cannot walk from the bedroom to the bathroom without resting and has fallen twice this year;
she can no longer toilet or prepare a meal without help.
With a rolling walker she manages 15 feet before stopping; a walker does not resolve the limitation.
Grip strength 9 kg right and 7 kg left; she cannot self-propel a manual wheelchair more than 20 feet.
Vision corrected to 20/30, judgement intact, and she operated a demonstration joystick safely.

Clinical note (Home assessment, dated 2026-04-10T12:00:00Z):
Home assessment by the supplier, 2026-04-10.
Doorways 34 inches or wider, 5-foot turning space in the kitchen and bathroom, level floors.
The home accommodates a power wheelchair.

value.rationale: The mobility examination documents that the member cannot toilet or prepare a meal without help, which are daily activities in the home.
The mobility examination explicitly states that a walker does not resolve the limitation.
The mobility examination documents that the member cannot self-propel a manual wheelchair more than 20 feet, which is not far enough to complete daily activities like toileting or preparing a meal.
The home assessment is dated 2026-04-10, which is more than 60 days before the mobility examination date of 2026-09-02.
The mobility examination documents that the member has vision corrected to 20/30, intact judgement, and safely operated a demonstration joystick.
